command: python3 -m gak_conformance digest|verify against published evidence

defects.detail: §5.2 certification accepted as a §5.1 receipt. Happy-path hash happens to match because both carry the same 13 (id,status) pairs under harness v1.
14-clause v1.1 receipt hashed under default harness string gak-conformance/v1. Exit 0 emits a plausible but wrong identity.
Same silent wrong hash when the inbound file is a certification.
Receipt passed as --cert fail-closes, but the error is a KeyError string, not an artifact-type contract.

defects.command: verify fixture against a v1.1 fixture certification without --harness
defects.detail: CLI default --harness v1 overrides the certification harness_version. Looks like kernel drift. Re-run with --harness gak-conformance/v1.1 exits 0 VERIFIED.

defects.command: digest --receipt <published v1 receipt with timestamp added>
defects.detail: Spec §5.1 forbids timestamp. Extra key is ignored; file is still treated as a conforming receipt.
